top_choice_rationale: Targeted protein degradation is the one new physical-chemical principle on the slate that is already widely reproduced: a small molecule induces a ternary complex and the cell's ubiquitin machinery does the work, so activity rests on cooperativity and kinetics, not occupancy. Crews and Deshaies conceived the PROTAC and Handa's cereblon work gives the molecular basis of the thalidomide-type degraders, so a citation built on induced proximity covers one concept honestly. The absence of an approved degrader and the Ciulli exclusion are real costs, so I place the Ciulli variant (P005) next and the mature C-N coupling prize (P004) third, ahead of the pairings that include base editing, which is an engineered fusion on the platform recognised in 2020.
recusal_note: none apparent from profile; Lund colleagues Linke and Somfai sit on the committee but no candidate connection to any proposed laureate is apparent
